title: Croatian-Style Stew with Fried Tomatoes
description: A twist on traditional Indian cuisine, this hearty stew combines the flavors of Croatia with the spices of India. Served with crispy fried tomatoes.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the Croatian sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the tomato paste, spices, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat oil in a separate pan over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced tomatoes and fry until crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Serve the stew with fried tomatoes on top.
